summary: Sertex — Görev Şablonları (Task Templates) e2e verification on web + mobile + backend. Backend pytest 7/7 PASS. Web UI (TemplateBar + TemplatesModal + TemplateFormModal): full CRUD + 'Kullan' (instantiate) works — creates real task, opens task edit modal, cross-platform parity confirmed (web-created template visible on mobile). Mobile UI (/templates screen): CRUD works, form fields OK, save OK, but the 'Kullan' (instantiate) button did NOT create a task via Expo web preview — API works when hit directly (confirmed via curl → 200 with new task). Console shows only dev-only hydration warning on web (dev instrumentation) and RN deprecation warnings on mobile.

issues: Dev-only hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — traced to Emergent visual-editor x-source instrumentation wrapping the mapped <option> children in a <span>. Not a runtime bug but produces console noise in dev; harmless in production build.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking the 'Kullan' Pressable in Expo Web preview did NOT trigger instantiate — no task was created (verified via API list). The neighbouring Edit form modal ended up open instead. Direct call to POST /api/task-templates/{id}/instantiate returned 200 with a proper task, so backend + client API method are fine — the failure is in the Pressable/onPress on Expo Web (possibly icon child stealing the tap, or missing hitSlop/z-order vs neighbouring edit icon Pressable). Reference: /app/mobile/app/templates.tsx:148-153.

integration_issues.issue: UI tap on 'Kullan' does not reach handleUse → api.instantiateTemplate never called; user sees no task and no navigation to /task/[id].

react_native_issues.component: React Native Web shadow* style props
react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' — needs migration from shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius to a single boxShadow style. Reference: repeated at load time on tasks + templates screens.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — move any pointerEvents={...} prop into the style object.

parity_issues.issue: Web UI creates task and opens edit modal; Mobile UI tap on 'Kullan' fails silently (no task created, no navigation).
parity_issues.expected: Both surfaces create the task and open the task detail/edit view
parity_issues.actual: Only web works end-to-end; mobile requires API-level invocation.

parity_issues.issue: Templates and instantiated tasks created on one surface are visible on the other (shared backend, /api/task-templates + /api/tasks).
parity_issues.actual: Confirmed — web-created 'Test WEB TPL …' template and its instantiated task showed up on mobile.

action_items: Fix mobile Kullan (template-use-<id>) tap on Expo Web preview so it fires handleUse → api.instantiateTemplate → router.push('/task/{id}'). Likely candidates: (a) add hitSlop and ensure the useBtn Pressable's onPress isn't shadowed by the neighbouring edit-icon Pressable when they lay out on the same row on narrow widths; (b) verify child <Ionicons/Text> aren't intercepting the press via any accessibilityRole/href on web. Test with Playwright targeting exact [data-testid='template-use-<id>'] click.
Migrate React Native Web deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' → 'boxShadow', 'props.pointerEvents' → 'style.pointerEvents'. Sweep /app/mobile/src and /app/mobile/app.
(Nice-to-have) Silence dev-only hydration warning '<span> in <option>' by asking the visual-editor instrumentation to skip <option> children — no user impact, dev console noise only.
critical_code_review_comments: templates_router.py is well-structured and honours the scope=personal/shared visibility with a proper $or query. `_can_view_template` uses get_user_company_ids() first — good multi-company support.
In-memory `_tpl_upload_sessions` dict for chunked uploads is not clustered — fine for single-worker deployments but will break with multi-replica scale-out. Not blocking for current preview.

instantiate_template best-effort attachment copy: swallows all exceptions (log-only). If storage fails, user gets a task without attachments and no signal. Consider returning a partial-warning field or logging metric.
TemplateFormModal (web) auto-open subtasks section: OK; attachments block only appears after first save — good UX for chunked upload (needs template id).
seed_data_creation: None retained — all test templates and tasks were permanently deleted via API at teardown (verified: 'Remaining test templates: 0').
